pairs.question: Which president was older at their first inauguration?
pairs.fact: Cleveland is one of only two presidents to serve two non-consecutive terms.

pairs.question: Which country has the bigger economy?
pairs.fact: The US and China together make up about 40% of the world economy.

pairs.question: Gram for gram, which has less vitamin C?
pairs.fact: Gram for gram, a guava or a red bell pepper has more vitamin C than an orange.

pairs.question: Which roller coaster is taller?
pairs.fact: Kingda Ka in New Jersey was the world's tallest coaster at 456 feet until it closed in 2024.

pairs.question: Who hit more career home runs?
pairs.fact: Pujols hit his 700th home run in September 2022, in his final season.

pairs.question: Which airport is busier?
pairs.fact: Atlanta has been the world's busiest airport by passengers almost every year since 1998.

pairs.question: Which Broadway show ran for more performances?
pairs.fact: The Phantom of the Opera played 13,981 performances over 35 years, the longest run in Broadway history.

pairs.question: Which is shorter?
pairs.fact: Coastline lengths depend on how closely you measure: the finer the ruler, the longer the coast.

pairs.question: Which LEGO set has fewer pieces?
pairs.fact: The 2022 LEGO Eiffel Tower has 10,001 pieces and stands almost 5 feet tall.
